description: Diodes AZ1084C — 3.3V fixed LDO regulator, 5A max output, 1.3V typical dropout at 5A. TO-252 (DPAK) package. For high-current 3.3V rails where AMS1117 is insufficient.
name: az1084c-3v3
watch_out_for: 1.3V typ dropout: feed >=4.7V for 3.3V out. Needs >=10uF output cap (tantalum/electrolytic ESR aids stability). Tab pour for heat.
